summary_en: The European Commission recently proposed the EU Children's Act, intended to unify rules for the protection of minors in digital services: children under 13 would be banned from social media, those aged 13 to 15 could use parent-managed 'mini accounts', and those over 15 could open accounts independently. Data show that about 97% of young people in the EU go online daily, and 65% use social media as their main information source. Adolescent issues...

summary_en: The 7th CICA Summit was held in Baku on October 15, 2026.
